title: Medical literacy
learning_outcomes: Explain symptoms and signs in the context of medical literacy.
Compare and distinguish screening in the context of medical literacy.
Apply reference intervals in the context of medical literacy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about shared decisions in the context of medical literacy.

lessons.title: Symptoms and signs
lessons.outcome: Explain symptoms and signs in the context of medical literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving symptoms and signs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional consultation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain symptoms and signs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of symptoms and signs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Screening
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish screening in the context of medical literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving screening; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional consultation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain screening from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of screening; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reference intervals
lessons.outcome: Apply reference intervals in the context of medical literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reference intervals; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional consultation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reference intervals from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reference intervals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Shared decisions
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about shared decisions in the context of medical literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving shared decisions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional consultation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain shared decisions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of shared decisions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of symptoms and signs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of screening; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reference intervals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of shared decisions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
